title: Understanding Layer Patching in Model Size Interpolation
abstract: arXiv:2607.08170v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Layer patching is a key technique for model size interpolation in large language models (LLMs), in which a subset of a distilled student model's layers is replaced with corresponding teacher-model layers to construct intermediate-sized models without additional training. Prior work largely ignores the order in which layers are patched, which we show can dramatically affect the performance and reliability of the resulting models. In this work, we study the role of layer patching in model size interpolation. We cast finding the optimal layer subset for each model size as an optimization problem and prove it can be viewed as a shortest-path problem in a certain acyclic graph. In experiments, we show that patching strongly shapes interpolation behavior, with effects that vary substantially across model families. translated_title: 理解模型尺寸插值中的层修补技术
translated_abstract: 层修补是大语言模型（LLM）模型尺寸插值中的一项关键技术，其做法是将蒸馏学生模型的一部分层替换为对应的教师模型层，从而在无需额外训练的情况下构建中等尺寸的模型。以往的工作大多忽略了层修补的顺序，而我们证明这一顺序会显著影响所得模型的性能与可靠性。在本工作中，我们研究了层修补在模型尺寸插值中的作用。我们将为每个模型尺寸寻找最优层子集的问题形式化为一个优化问题，并证明它可以被视为某个有向无环图中的最短路径问题。在实验中，我们表明层修补强烈地塑造了插值行为，且其效果在不同模型家族之间存在显著差异。我们发现简单的顺序策略——无论是从第一层到最后一层还是从最后一层到第一层进行修补——（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将大语言模型尺寸插值中为每个模型尺寸寻找最优层修补子集的问题形式化为有向无环图上的最短路径问题，并揭示了层修补顺序对插值模型性能和可靠性的决定性影响。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the selection of optimal layer subsets for model size interpolation as a shortest-path problem on an acyclic graph, revealing that the order of layer patching dramatically affects the performance and reliability of the resulting models.
